channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Tesla Sets Timeline for Customer Vehicles in Robotaxi Fleet
item.description: Tesla announced during its third-quarter earnings call that vehicle owners may incorporate their cars into its autonomous taxi network next year. Elon Musk has previously made repeated pledges regarding this unsupervised self-driving feature.

item.title: US Directs Staff to Leave Saudi Arabia Due to Houthi Risks
item.description: The US State Department has mandated the evacuation of personnel from Saudi Arabia. Officials pointed to escalating hostile actions by Iran-backed Houthi forces targeting the kingdom.

item.title: Treasury Estimates Potential Value of UK North Sea Oil Fund
item.description: The UK Treasury has published its initial calculation regarding the wealth the nation could have accumulated by investing revenues from North Sea oil extraction.

item.title: Attack on King Fahd Airport Leaves One Dead and Eight Injured
item.description: Saudi civil aviation authorities reported that an assault on King Fahd airport resulted in one fatality and eight injuries. Officials are currently evaluating the extent of the physical damage.

item.title: BJD Criticizes BJP for Targeting Naveen Over CJP Release Demand
item.description: The BJD condemned the BJP for personal attacks against Naveen following his call to release CJP figures, while the BJP accused him of inciting unrest.

item.title: Rice Endorses Kane for Ballon d'Or Following Bayern Match
item.description: Declan Rice has expressed support for his England teammate Harry Kane to win the Ballon d'Or. The endorsement follows Bayern Munich's Champions League match against Arsenal.

item.title: Young UK Graduates Consider Emigrating Amid Job Market Struggles
item.description: A growing number of young adults are reportedly looking to move abroad as securing entry-level employment within the UK becomes increasingly difficult for recent university graduates.

item.title: Macron Condemns Foreign Officials Over Remarks on French Riots
item.description: The French president criticized Donald Trump and other international figures for political remarks regarding ongoing domestic demonstrations.

item.title: Blackstone Executive Dismisses Concerns Over AI Infrastructure Debt
item.description: Jas Khaira, head of artificial intelligence at Blackstone, stated that market anxieties regarding debt used for AI expansion are exaggerated. The private equity firm remains unconcerned by ongoing market worries.

item.title: Australian Lawmakers Fund Personal Security After Threat Increases
item.description: Federal politicians in Australia are spending thousands of dollars on personal safety upgrades for their homes and offices. This trend follows security briefings from law enforcement and intelligence agencies regarding rising threats.

item.title: Meta Proposes New Share Class to Finance Artificial Intelligence
item.description: To fund extensive development in artificial intelligence models and applications, the technology company is designing a fresh stock category.

item.title: Mikel Arteta Concerned Over Bukayo Saka Quadriceps Injury
item.description: Following a Champions League match against Bayern Munich, Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta stated that Bukayo Saka's quad injury appears serious.

item.title: Airbnb Updates Policy to Ban Mandatory Guest Cleaning Tasks
item.description: Under revised guidelines taking effect for bookings made from November 20 onward, property owners can no longer require visitors to wash dishes or strip beds.

item.title: Pundits Discuss Harry Kane's Potential Ballon d'Or Chances
item.description: Pundits analyze whether the impressive performance of England captain and Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane makes him a contender for the Ballon d'Or.

item.title: Women Discuss Chronic UTIs on Social Media to End Stigma
item.description: To overcome the taboo surrounding chronic urinary tract infections, women are using digital platforms to share their personal health struggles.

item.title: German Youth Movement Organizes Nationwide October Protests
item.description: Youth organizers in Germany have scheduled large-scale demonstrations across major urban centers for October 31, inspired by French protests.

item.title: Clinical Trial to Test ADHD and Diabetes Drugs on Alzheimer's
item.description: Researchers are simultaneously evaluating existing diabetes and attention deficit medications on dementia patients to accelerate Alzheimer's treatment discovery.

item.title: Keeley McKee Speaks Out After Mother's 2003 Partner Homicide
item.description: Keeley McKee, whose mother Leanne was murdered by her fiancé in 2003 shortly before their wedding, declares she will not become another victim.

item.title: Match analysts review Manchester United loss and team tactics
item.description: Following Manchester United's 4-1 Champions League loss to Como, pundits Nedum Onuoha and Stephen Warnock evaluated the squad's performance. They also addressed midfielder Bruno Fernandes' remarks regarding the club's strategy.

item.title: Actor Noel Clarke denies sex offense allegations in court
item.description: British performer and director Noel Clarke attended a London tribunal on Wednesday. He entered a plea of not guilty regarding six allegations, which incorporate two counts of sexual assault.

item.title: AI infrastructure expansion threatens Texas air quality progress
item.description: The rapid construction of new data centers in Texas to support generative AI could reverse years of air pollution improvements. These facilities demand massive amounts of energy, risking a return to emission levels not witnessed since the 2000s.

item.title: US immigration policies and hiring freezes impact Indian tech staff
item.description: Stricter US immigration policies combined with reduced foreign recruitment by technology companies are hindering permanent residency goals for numerous Indian professionals.

item.title: Canadian publishing house drops author over generative AI usage
item.description: Publisher Boreal canceled its relationship with Haitian-Canadian author Thelyson Orelien. An inquiry verified that the writer utilized artificial intelligence in creating his recent novel.

item.title: Musk discusses potential historic merger of Tesla and SpaceX
item.description: The chief executive of both enterprises argues that combining Tesla and SpaceX would yield significant benefits. This potential consolidation would constitute the largest corporate merger in history.

item.title: Airbnb visitor cleaning restrictions draw criticism from property owners
item.description: Airbnb's decision to ban hosts from demanding tasks like bed stripping has triggered threats of boycotts. Property owners express frustration over the new policy limiting guest chores.

item.title: Ramayana film schedules theatrical premiere and pay-per-view release
item.description: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will debut in theaters on November 5, 2026, before launching on JioHotstar via pay-per-view. The strategy intends to broaden access to the film throughout India.

item.title: Texas family property sold for over $10 million to create park
item.description: The Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation purchased a 650-acre East Texas ranch from the Pollard family for upwards of $10 million. The lakefront property, owned since 1940, will be transformed into a public state park.

item.title: Danbury warehouse sold for $6.75M to Buck family relative
item.description: A relative of Subway's co-founder acquired a Danbury warehouse formerly owned by the Salame family for $6.75 million. The new owner intends to invest $1.8 million to renovate the property while keeping its industrial function.

item.title: Footage captures settler attacking Palestinian child near Yatta
item.description: A video document records an Israeli settler yelling at and physically striking a Palestinian child. The incident occurred during an assault targeting a family located east of Yatta.

item.title: Zuckerberg states Meta is shifting into a new era with Muse
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg anticipates that the Muse agent will yield higher revenue per user than existing apps. He described this development as a new phase for the enterprise.

item.title: Meta Receives Record $25 Billion Penalty Over Data Privacy Misstatements
item.description: The parent company of Facebook faces a record $25 billion financial penalty regarding user data privacy. This punishment surpasses a previous $18 billion legal settlement reached with California regulators.

item.title: Paris restricts protests as Macron criticizes foreign leaders
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron condemned foreign leaders for making foolish remarks for political advantage. Concurrently, law enforcement in Paris will prolong gathering prohibitions across designated areas of the capital on Thursday.

item.title: Fernandes criticizes strategy following Manchester United defeat
item.description: Manchester United suffered a 4-1 Champions League defeat in Como, extending their winless streak. Following the match, captain Bruno Fernandes openly criticized the team's tactical approach.

item.title: Audio equipment maker Bose acquires competitor Skullcandy
item.description: Bose has completed the purchase of rival audio brand Skullcandy. The acquiring company views this move as an opportunity to expand its consumer reach.

item.title: Sudanese conflict intensifies amid UN regional crisis warnings
item.description: The ongoing war in Sudan continues to expand regionally, highlighted by a drone strike in Abyei that reportedly caused 153 deaths. Following an emergency international gathering, the UN envoy for Sudan discussed the worsening situation.

item.title: Supreme Court questions exclusion of uninsured cars in relief plan
item.description: Justices JB Pardiwala and KV Viswanathan noted that the interim relief scheme for crash victims lacks proper notification and publicity. The Supreme Court directed the government to raise public awareness regarding these rights.

item.title: Iranian Actor Depicts US Leader Imprisoned in Tehran Square
item.description: A performer in a crowded Tehran public square portrayed Donald Trump locked behind prison bars. The street display drew attention in the Iranian capital.

item.title: Microsoft Considers Hourly Fees for Owned Title Cloud Streaming
item.description: Gamers might face hourly costs ranging from 24 to 40 cents to stream titles they already own. This usage fee would be charged separately from the initial game purchase.

item.title: Moscow Expresses Willingness for Ukraine Conflict Negotiations
item.description: Russia stated it is prepared to restart discussions with the United States and Ukraine. This declaration followed a meeting in St. Petersburg between Vladimir Putin and US envoy Steve Witkoff.

item.title: Rosatom Delivers Safety Control Hardware for Kudankulam Reactors
item.description: About 300 apparatus pieces for safety and control systems have been manufactured and shipped for units three and four of the Indian nuclear facility. The delivery includes four instrumentation sets for each VVER-1000 power unit.

item.title: Australian Capital Cities Experience Simultaneous Housing Price Drops
item.description: Property values are declining in every Australian capital simultaneously for the first time in 15 years. Sydney values dropped by 4.7 percent during the September quarter to reach a two-year low.

item.title: Real Madrid Defeats RB Leipzig to Maintain Champions League Streak
item.description: Real Madrid secured a 4-1 victory against RB Leipzig with goals from Kylian Mbappe and Yan Diomande. This win marks three consecutive victories in the current tournament.

item.title: Drone Strike Remnants at Saudi Oil Site Leave Two Dead
item.description: Debris from a Houthi drone strike at a Saudi petroleum facility resulted in two fatalities and multiple injuries. The deceased victims were nationals of Nepal and the Philippines, while the injured included people from Pakistan and India.

item.title: Airbnb Updates Policy to Prohibit Guest Cleaning Duties
item.description: The lodging platform has prohibited property owners from requiring guests to handle washing dishes and similar tasks. Chores typically handled by professional cleaners are no longer permitted guest requirements.

item.title: Jamia University Establishes Committee for Student Union Charter
item.description: Jamia authorities created a panel to draft a constitution for a student union amid ongoing student demonstrations. Additionally, officials announced a review of disciplinary measures taken against protesters between October 12 and 21.

item.title: Arsenal Secures 2-2 Draw Against Bayern Munich
item.description: Arsenal and Bayern Munich tied 2-2 in a Champions League match. Bukayo Saka opened the scoring for Arsenal, followed by goals from Alphonso Davies and Harry Kane for Bayern before Declan Rice equalized.

item.title: Kim Yo Jong Threatens Seoul Over Border Dispute
item.description: North Korean official Kim Yo Jong announced that border loudspeakers will be activated soon. This follows remarks by a South Korean defense adviser who blamed Pyongyang for landmine injuries.

item.title: Real Madrid Triumphs Over Leipzig in Champions League
item.description: Real Madrid secured a 4-1 victory against Leipzig to continue their winning streak in the tournament. Bernardo Silva netted his debut goal for Madrid following his summer transfer from Manchester City.

item.title: Mexican Prosecutor Faces Treason Charges Over US Raid
item.description: Authorities in Mexico have charged a prosecutor with treason. The case stems from an April anti-narcotics operation involving American agents that sparked legal debates.

item.title: Proposed Changes to Driving License Tests and Rules
item.description: A new regulatory draft proposes raising the driving tutorial pass requirement and extending the session duration to thirty minutes. The stricter guidelines also outline standardized procedures for online license modifications.

item.title: রিয়াল মাদ্রিদের বড় জয় লাইপজিগের বিপক্ষে
item.description: লাইপজিগের বিপক্ষে ৪-১ গোলের বড় ব্যবধানে জয় পেয়েছে রিয়াল মাদ্রিদ। ম্যাচটিতে গোল করেছেন বের্নার্দো সিলভা, আরদা গুলের, কিলিয়ান এমবাপ্পে ও ইয়ান দিওমান্দে।

item.title: Enterprises keep buying software upgrades that IT thinks will make things worse
item.description: As reported by Ars Technica, Survey of 2,018 IT heads at big firms points to a lack of leverage. Key points: Enterprises, Survey, enterprises, buying.

item.title: মিউনিখে বায়ার্ন ও আর্সেনালের ম্যাচ ড্র
item.description: বায়ার্ন মিউনিখের বিপক্ষে ২-২ গোলে ড্র করেছে আর্সেনাল। ভিনসেন্ট কোম্পানি ও মানুয়েল ন্যয়ারের খেলা নিয়ে অনিশ্চয়তা থাকলেও শেষ পর্যন্ত তারা মাঠে ছিলেন।

item.title: Meta introduces new share class to support AI and corporate expansion
item.description: During its third-quarter financial update, Meta announced plans to issue non-voting stock. These shares are intended to provide capital for artificial intelligence projects, company acquisitions, and employee compensation.

item.title: Discussion focuses on religious nationalism's impact on US democracy
item.description: Former defense official Jim Townsend and Michael Weinstein of the Military Religious Freedom Foundation joined François Picard to analyze political shifts. The segment explored concerns regarding the influence of specific religious ideologies within the US military under the Trump administration.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 set for November in Boston
item.description: On November 4, 2026, entrepreneurs from various business stages will gather in Boston to network with venture capitalists. The event focuses on providing founders with practical guidance on building and expanding their organizations.

item.title: Meta's AI assistant Muse reaches 10 million user milestone
item.description: In its latest quarterly financial report, Meta announced that its Muse application has grown significantly. The company noted that users are primarily engaging with the tool for digital shopping and improving personal productivity.

item.title: Tesla reports 43 percent profit decrease for third quarter
item.description: The company's financial results for Q3 2026 show a significant drop in earnings compared to previous periods. This decline coincided with a reduction in the output of Tesla's energy storage department.

item.title: Aston Villa continues unbeaten Champions League run with win over Viking
item.description: The English club secured its third victory in as many games by beating the Norwegian side Viking. This dominant performance has moved the team into second place in the tournament's league standings.

item.title: Trump campaigns in South Carolina as Senate race becomes more competitive
item.description: Donald Trump is visiting the state to support Senator Darline Graham, sister of the late Lindsey Graham, in her reelection bid against Democrat Annie Andrews. The trip aims to boost the Republican candidate as the political contest narrows.
